jobs_lease_shape.name: jobs_lease_shape
jobs_lease_shape.value: ("jobs"."status"='running' and "jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "jobs"."lease_until" is not null) or ("jobs"."status"<>'running' and "jobs"."lease_token" is null and "jobs"."lease_until" is null)

jobs_completion_shape.name: jobs_completion_shape
jobs_completion_shape.value: ("jobs"."status" in ('done','dead_letter') and "jobs"."completed_at" is not null) or ("jobs"."status" not in ('done','dead_letter') and "jobs"."completed_at" is null)

maintenance_result_bounds.name: maintenance_result_bounds
maintenance_result_bounds.value: "maintenance_results"."nonces_deleted"<="maintenance_results"."batch_limit" and "maintenance_results"."runs_deleted"<="maintenance_results"."batch_limit" and (not "maintenance_results"."held" or ("maintenance_results"."nonces_deleted"=0 and "maintenance_results"."runs_deleted"=0 and not "maintenance_results"."more_possible"))

queue_entry_ticket_bounds.name: queue_entry_ticket_bounds
queue_entry_ticket_bounds.value: "queue_entries"."ticket" between 1 and 1099511627775 and ("queue_entries"."priority_ticket" is null or "queue_entries"."priority_ticket" between 1 and 1099511627775)

receipt_slot_shape.name: receipt_slot_shape
receipt_slot_shape.value: ("receipt_allocations"."receiver_kind"='empty_queue_business' and "receipt_allocations"."receiver_entry_id" is null and "receipt_allocations"."slot_index" is null) or ("receipt_allocations"."receiver_kind" in ('member','bootstrap') and "receipt_allocations"."receiver_entry_id" is not null and (("receipt_allocations"."lineage_status"='captured' and "receipt_allocations"."slot_index" is not null and "receipt_allocations"."slot_index">0) or ("receipt_allocations"."lineage_status"='legacy_linked' and "receipt_allocations"."slot_index" is null)))

receipt_beneficiary_shape.name: receipt_beneficiary_shape
receipt_beneficiary_shape.value: ("receipt_allocations"."receiver_kind"='member' and "receipt_allocations"."beneficiary_user_id" is not null and "receipt_allocations"."beneficiary_user_id"<>"receipt_allocations"."payer_user_id" and "receipt_allocations"."recipient_role" is null) or ("receipt_allocations"."receiver_kind" in ('bootstrap','empty_queue_business') and "receipt_allocations"."beneficiary_user_id" is null and "receipt_allocations"."recipient_role" is not null and "receipt_allocations"."recipient_role" in ('developer','marketing','platform','custom_bootstrap'))
